g.text: MORE SHOPPERS. SMALLER BASKETS. EVERY ITEM COUNTS.
64,330 transactions verified · 42 stores · 3 provinces · 119 stockout events · FY2025
by a 10.56% drop in items per basket,
Basket value slid nearly every month —
from R299.82 in January to R248.56 in
December. A 17.1% fall across the year,
so loyalty alone isn't the full answer.
Baskets aren't shrinking because of price — shoppers are buying fewer items per
trip, and it is getting worse every month. Fix why items per basket are falling first.
